arguments.sql:
SELECT s.rtype, COUNT(*) AS sat_rows, COUNT(f.CDSCode) AS meal_matches,
       COUNT(s.sname) AS named_schools, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT typeof(s.NumGE1500)) AS score_types,
       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT typeof(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)")) AS meal_types
FROM satscores AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
GROUP BY s.rtype

SELECT s.rtype, COUNT(*) AS sat_rows, COUNT(f.CDSCode) AS meal_matches,

       GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT typeof(f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)")) AS meal_types
FROM satscores AS s
LEFT JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
GROUP BY s.rtype

arguments.sql:
SELECT MAX(
    f."Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)" / NULLIF(f."Enrollment (Ages 5-17)", 0)
) AS highest_free_meal_eligibility_rate
FROM frpm AS f
JOIN satscores AS s ON s.cds = f.CDSCode
WHERE s.rtype = 'S'
  AND CAST(s.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / NULLIF(s.NumTstTakr, 0) > 0.3
LIMIT 1
